SDT - Sensor Data Transducer                                                                                                           M 1501 403 E-EN-2015-02



















Product Features:

          Suitable for all brakes and HPU
          20 x sensor inputs
          Inputs available as bypass for PLC
          Status display for inputs, power and troubleshooting
          Easy and fast screw pluggable ter           minal blocks
          Robust daisy chain SIBRE bus
          IP65 & marine painting enclosure
